messages.subject: Re: graphing time data on x and y axis?
parts:
I think part of the problem is that you don't have you date's properly formated. See this blog post for some help. Once you get your dates in the right format, you're going to have to use the new scales package to get the format and breaks that you're after. Sadly, it's not something I do a lot so we'll need more help. 


Something like: 

yy$Date<-as.POSIXct(yy$Date, format="%Y-%m-%d")

yy$STime<-as.POSIXct(yy$STime, format="%H:%M")
yy$ETime<-as.POSIXct(yy$ETime, format="%H:%M")


ggplot(yy, aes(Date, ETime, group="Team")) + 
geom_jitter() + 
facet_wrap( ~ Team) + 
geom_hline(yintercept=yy$Stime, colour="red", size=2)

#Except it errors out because your data is all the same
#Error in prettyDate(x = x, n = n, min.n = min.n, sep = sep, ...) : 
# range too small for min.n
